content:
Jamie: Heads up — SAP HW + Marketplace listing go-live targeted next Tue 09:00 PT. We need a clear partner SEV path + shared war room. Who can own the ops lane?
Olivia: I can run coordination. Proposal: create #partner-sap-launch (private) + a single canary bridge for post-merger support. Also suggest 72h intensified support window.
Marcus: +1 on the private channel. SRE needs a primary oncall and fallback. We should pre-warm fallback model variants on Dedicated. Sam, can you take primary for the launch window?
Sam: I can be primary from Tue 06:00–18:00 PT for day 1, and overnight on-call for day 2. Need a short, actionable runbook and an escalation matrix (pager -> slack -> bridge).
Alex: Partner asks we own the bridge ops and manage recording for postmortem. They want a single point of contact for SI integrators during incidents.
Rachel: Support will cover 24h for first 72h. I'll add two rotations: EMEA handover and APAC buddy. Please confirm expected SLAs for first 24h (response/ack).
Jen: Reminder from legal: embargo window is 48h before announcement. Keep announcement channels gated and only share the marketing doc with the gated list. No public screenshots before the go-live.
Olivia: Channel naming proposal: `#partner-sap-launch` (private) and `#partner-sap-ops` (read-only for partner watchers). Create only the private one for warroom; we can spin up watchers as needed.
Marcus: Escalation sketch: Pager (PagerDuty) -> #partner-sap-launch ping -> primary SRE -> Marcus backup -> on-call SM -> exec liaison. Add cross-org pager for partner-facing Sev1.
Sam: Quick runbook snippet I'm drafting:
```
1) Triage: confirm scope (infra vs partner config)
2) Contain: switch to fallback model variant
3) Notify: ping #partner-sap-launch + pager
4) Bridge: start Zoom + record (ops@redwood)
5) Escalate: follow matrix in doc
```
Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/partner-sap-launch (internal)
Alex: Partner asks for a nightly sync 22:00 PT for first 3 nights. Can we do a 10-15m recap in the channel and a short incident digest?
Rachel: Affirmative. Support will post a status digest at 22:00 PT with open items and triage notes.
Jamie: Who's owner of the marketplace listing rollback plan? Need a simple command path to revert listing and switch traffic back to old image.
Olivia: Marketplace lead (me) + Marcus for rollback approval. I'll prepare the rollback checklist and QA gating.
Marcus: Add a cutover flag we can flip: `marketplace_cutover=false` to revert. Ops will have the runbook step and a small ramp window.
partnerbot: New private channel created: #partner-sap-launch by Olivia (assigned: Jamie, Olivia, Marcus, Sam, Alex, Rachel)
Sam: I'll finalize the runbook and post to the channel by EOD today.
Jen: I'll prep the minimal legal clearance note to post to the channel once marketing copy is finalized.
Olivia: Action items:
- Olivia: create channel + invite partner watchers (today)
- Sam: finalize runbook (EOD)
- Marcus: setup pager + cutover flag (today)
- Rachel: publish 72h oncall rota and 22:00 digests (today)
- Jamie: confirm exec liaison and post release window (today)
Jamie: Sounds good. If anything goes Sev1, escalate immediately to the bridge and tag @exec-liaison. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Marcus: Adding small test tomorrow at 09:00 PT to verify bridge and rollback path. Expect a 5-min simulated failover.
Alex: Partner confirmed they can join the simulated failover. Good to test.
Olivia: I'll post the final checklist and embargoed marketing copy into the channel once ready. Keep comms minimal until then.
Rachel: Noted. I'll queue backups and standby docs for the team.
Sam: Ready — will post runbook in channel shortly.
Jamie: Closing for now — channel will be the single source of truth during the launch. Ping here for any blockers.
